column3: With respect to the Target Sayville Mortgage Loan (2.2%), the sole tenant, Target, has a right of first offer (“ROFO”) to purchase the Mortgaged Property prior to it being marketed for sale. The ROFO is not extinguished by foreclosure. The loan documents include due-on-sale provisions prohibiting any such property transfer without the lender’s consent. The lease definition of “transfer” excludes a mortgage, but is silent as to whether a foreclosure or deed-in-lieu would trigger.
